text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CST, according to analysts.

CANOLA - C$0.30 to C$0.50/tonne up in follow-through shortcovering rally from Friday's close with prospects of Japanese export demand overnight. Gains should be tempered by bearish calls in nearby CBOT soycomplex calls and near ideal South American crop and weather conditions. The Canadian dollar fell against the Japanese yen to 90.68 from 91.19. March futures crush profit margin rose to -26.59 from -27.43 Thursday based on CBOT soy oil and meal.
FLAX - Steady on technical support and short covering.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.20 to C$0.30 up on higher CBOT corn calls with gains tempered by late sentiments Friday's late hedges may resume.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 higher on allied feed grain market calls with gains tempered by expected commercial selling of March and farmer hedges.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
